data.name: ARES
data.detailed_description:
Embark into a lore-rich online Milsim campaign with detailed virtual reality interactions in this military sandbox game. Experience the story from multiple perspectives as Infantry, drive vehicles, aircraft, and more.

After over a decade, this community-fated story campaign finally gets the home it deserves,

This is ARES.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――

INTERACTIVE VR SYSTEMS

Kick in doors, climb ladders, manipulate your weapon, interact with vehicles, and more.

Utilize direct contact feedback, and open a new world of interaction unique to ARES.

CAMPAIGN

Take part in the extremely lore-rich storyline crafted for literally over a decade in the deep-history

of this alternate reality. From hidden intel documents, to in-world mysteries, and faction diplomacy.

Your choices and interactions with the game will affect the outcome of the Global Campaign, including
other players also participating, fating history itself.

TRUE VEHICLES

Full-simulation aircraft and vehicles that give a first-hand interaction basis to

allow you to truly take control, thinning the line of reality and virtual reality.

From advanced avionics, water displacement, and engine torque, each vehicle

feels part of the world and not just a gameplay mechanic.

DENS ENGINE

Experience destruction and true surface tension like you've never seen before.

Explosives deform terrain, shockwaves shatter windows, structures collapse-

Each surface, object, vehicle, and weapon down to the casings they eject simulate

accurate and immersive ballistics data to truly give you a Milsim experience.

ADVANCED BALLISTICS

Firing your weapon is not just a gameplay feature. Air pressure, weather, gravity,

and even the way you hold it will affect your shot. Experience a simulated ballistics

system like you've never seen before. Shoot through walls, shatter glass, and redefine

what is "cover" and "concealment" in a video game.

INDIVIDUAL CUSTOMIZATION

Mount attachments, replace receiver groups, alternate your grip, and modify optics to

truly fit your preference. Expand past just your weapon, change fatigues, alternate mounts,

gear up with rigs and plate carriers- Individual customization effects your weapon and gear's

performance, weight, interactions with the world, and more.

ADAPTIVE AUDIO

Experience audio-based immersion like you've never before. Hear and feel everything around you,

from explosions, to footsteps, to the rumble of a tank passing by.

TRUE MILSIM SANDBOX

ARES is more than a game- Utilize the in-game mission builder and level editor-

use it for specific scenarios, train your shot with true-to-world weather effects, bullet

ballistics, smart enemy conflicts, and make it your experience.

data.short_description: ARES is a VR Milsim platform with interactive features, simulated combat scenarios, and customization options. Play solo or online with other players in different gamemodes across an open milsim sandbox experience rooted deep in player-driven campaigns missions, & scenarios. Gear up and embark!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 & Above
  • Processor: Multicore Processor
  • Graphics: VR Capable Graphics Card
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • VR Support: VR Support

content_descriptors.notes: ARES is a game about realism, war is not pretty and the horrors of that are showcased in this game. Various dark themes and deaths are seen throughout the game, including scenes of war violence and crimes.
